api.description: The project root of the node-app, for example apps/backend.

owner.description: The GitHub owner of the repo. The images are ghcr.io/<owner>/<name>-<app>, in lowercase.

name.description: The Dokploy project, and the prefix of the images and the Traefik routers. The workspace scope by default.

server.description: The Hetzner Cloud server that runs Dokploy.

host.description: A DNS name in a Hetzner zone, for example app.example.com. Without it, the host is <name>.<server ipv4>.sslip.io.

zone.description: The Hetzner zone of host. The host without its first label by default.

database.description: The project root of a Prisma package with a Dockerfile.migration, for example packages/db. It adds Postgres and the one-shot migrate service.

registryUser.description: The GitHub user whose classic token with read:packages is the GHCR_PULL_TOKEN secret. It adds a Dokploy registry, so the server pulls private images.
